producer_report.summary:
I wrote the independent review and marked the design as reviewed. The verdict is accept with changes. I only read the code. I did not run anything, so the review's citations are for you to verify. `cargo fmt`, `clippy` and `test` were not run, since only markdown files changed. The listed boundary words do not appear in the review file (checked with a grep).

The review (`docs/design/reviews/parallel-jobs-review-1.md`) has a table of the design's claims checked against the source, findings F1-F8 with severity, a decision with citations for each of the seven open questions, and a section on today's evidence. A last table says which findings can be fixed in the design now and which belong to later jobs.

Main findings:
- **F1 (high):** `plan` in `land.rs` lines 52-73 only replays a candidate when the branch gained records-only commits. Any governed change, including `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/`, sends a later job stale even if its files don't overlap. So parallel change jobs mostly go stale after the first. The review answers open question 2 this way.
- **F2 (high):** `Athena` holds `Box<dyn AgentDriver>`, and that trait has no `Send` or `Sync` bound at `agent/src/lib.rs` line 139. `Ui` has none either. The review decides on separate processes by default, subject to the spike.
- **F3 (high):** The design says nothing about shared append-only files, such as the two D81 entries and `CHANGELOG.md`. The stale-candidate re-verification is consistent with `land.rs` lines 74-80. The review recommends serializing jobs that name the same shared file and running the docs job last and alone. It also asks for a collision test.
- Lock order checks out: the job lock is always taken before the repository lock, in `run.rs`, `manage.rs` and `commits.rs`. Two line references in the design are off: 689 should be 698, and the range 1156-1210 should be 1165-1307.

Decisions on the other open questions:
- No run-level spend cap in the first build.
- `--all` runs `proposed` and `blocked` jobs only.
- Default of 2 workers with a ceiling of 4 (an estimate).
- Reject duplicate jobs up front.
- Keep the exit-code precedence as proposed.

Edits to existing files:
- **`parallel-jobs.md`:** I updated the status line, marked build-plan item 1 as done, and added a short "Response to review 1" section. The body is otherwise unchanged. The response says the review governs wherever the two differ, and a later design job still has to apply the changes.
- **`requirements-map.md` and `roadmap.md`:** I updated the status rows that mentioned the pending review.
open_issues: The design body is not rewritten. A later design job should apply findings F1-F3 and F7. The status line and the response section say the review governs where they differ.
The user's report of the CHANGELOG and D81 collisions and of the landing check refusing hand-merged squashes was not reproduced. The review labels the report as unchecked evidence.
The review's ceiling of 4 workers is an estimate, labeled as such.
mistakes: The review's claim that build_commit and advance take no lock rests on grep results for lock_repository and commit_records, not on reading those functions. It is labeled unchecked in the review.
I did not run the three Athena checks (fmt, clippy, test). The change touches only markdown files.
learnings: `plan` in land.rs (lines 52-73) replays a candidate with merge_tree only when the branch gained records-only commits. Any governed change on the branch makes a later job stale, even if the files don't overlap.
Governed content means everything except records/ and owner paths (athena-git attrs.rs 135-139). CHANGELOG, README and docs are governed.
`Athena` holds `Box<dyn AgentDriver>`, and the `AgentDriver` trait (agent/src/lib.rs line 139) has no Send+Sync bound. `Ui` has none either. `Capability` and `Pinner` do have the bound.
Lock order is job lock first, then repository lock, in every path. try_lock_job is called only at run.rs 116 and manage.rs 80.
The design's refuse_if_stopped line reference is off. The call is at run.rs 698, not 689. land_or_block spans lines 1165-1307, not 1156-1210.
desires: A way to run the code or tests to confirm the claims I only read. Bash was limited to cargo and git commands for this docs-only job.
